sources.ipg: IPG spec sheet G22-29856 rev. 00 for YLR-500-U3-SM-AC (quotes/ipg-ylr-500-u3-sm-ac.md): 1,500 W typ / 1,700 W max, 1,600 VA typ / 1,900 VA max at 500 W out; 200-240 VAC 1-phase; forced air; 10-35 C ambient
sources.pump: Edwards nXDS6i A73501983 (bom.csv G2), nXDS instruction manual A73501880 issue I (idealvac.com mirror, sha256 d04f0234..., read 2026-11-23 22:28Z): 100-127 V or 200-240 V +/-10 %, 1-phase 50/60 Hz, auto-sensing inverter drive; continuous rating 10 A rms at 100-127 V, 6 A rms at 200-240 V (Table 8); supply protection 10 A (Table 9); time-lag fuses or breakers, 'current transients can exceed the rated values' (issue B 3.6.1); RCD >= 30 mA 'to avoid trip during start up'; 260 W at ultimate, 170 W standby (Edwards catalogue page, search snippet). Taken at 208 V across L1-L2 at its 6 A rating while purging (power factor 0.6 assumed, so 749 W: a high side for the heat; the catalogue's 260 W at ultimate is the low side)
sources.blower_hi: McMaster 9960K51 regenerative blower (mcmaster-parts.csv): 1/8 hp, 115 V; taken as the upper bound
sources.blower_lo: sealed 24 V brushless blower: ~2.4 L/s (144 L/min, 2.5 m/s through 120 x 8 mm) against ~2 kPa is ~5 W of gas power; at 10-25 % blower efficiency, 20-50 W (estimate)
sources.heat: modules.md / analysis/out/thermal: 2 / 3 / 5 x 50 W cartridges (S25 / M50 / L75), worst steady 44 / 72 / 97 W at 200 C; Mean Well LRS-350-24 about 89 % efficient (datasheet)
sources.pc: 2U scan/laser controller PC with an RTC6 card: 80 W typical, 200 W rated (estimate)
sources.galvo: SCANLAB basiCube 20 on one 24 V rail, <= 2.6 A (SCANLAB basiCube series data, electrical.md section 0 point 4; it is not +/-15 V), through a Mean Well HDR-100-24 (~90 % efficient): 69 W rated, ~30 W typical (estimate)
sources.servo: three Teknic ClearPath-SD axes (recoater, Z, metering roller): ~10 W each holding/average, 100 W each peak (estimate)
sources.gas_inst: O2 analyzer (zirconia cell heater ~10-20 W), dew-point transmitter (~2 W), pressure transmitters, two 24 V solenoids (~8 W each when held) (estimates)
sources.ctrl: Pi 5 + cameras ~15 W, safety relay + guard lock + panel lamps ~15 W, network switch ~10 W, 24 V supply losses ~15 W (estimates)
sources.ups: Eaton 5PX1500RTG2 (bom.csv D2, the model's 2U unit, electrical.md 1.2): line-interactive, 1,500 VA / 1,500 W; ENERGY STAR UPS dataset (data.energystar.gov resource ifxy-2uty, read 2026-11-23 22:48Z): efficiency 98.6 % at 50 % and 75 % load, 98.4 % at 100 %, weighted 98.6 %; battery runtime 14 min at 50 % and 7 min at 100 % load. No 25 % or no-load figure is listed: 98.6 % at 25 % and a 10 W no-load draw are assumed. The Vertiv GXT5LI-1500 that byu-vcl PR 318 standardises on (online, 1,350 W, 88.8 % at 25 %, 29.1 W no-load) is D2's alternative
sources.dock: byu-vcl PR 318 services.py: dock 208Y/120 V, L1, L2, N, PE, 30 A breaker; CombiTac O3 mm contacts 39 A
sources.shuttle: byu-vcl PR 318 services.heat_budget: Shuttle enclosure 2.83 x 3.12 x 3.95 m, 55.9 m2 of walls and roof, 5.5 W/m2K for painted sheet steel in still air; Shuttle 1 idle 1,317 W (4.3 K), Shuttle 1 with a printer and the furnace working 3,720 W (12.1 K)
sources.chiller: byu-vcl PR 318: the shared chiller is a Thermo Scientific ThermoFlex 900, 900 W at +20 C
